8| 
9| /**
10|  * Snapshot of new activity since the last background todo pass.
11|  */
12| export interface IBackgroundTodoDelta {
13| 	/** The user's original request message (from the current or most recent turn). */
14| 	readonly userRequest: string;
15| 	/** New tool call rounds not yet seen by the background todo processor. */
16| 	readonly newRounds: readonly IToolCallRound[];
17| 	/** Full conversation history (read-only reference, stable within a turn). */
18| 	readonly history: readonly Turn[];
19| 	/** Session resource URI string, needed for todo tool invocation. */
20| 	readonly sessionResource: string | undefined;
21| }
22| 
23| /**
24|  * Tracks which tool-call rounds the background todo processor has already
25|  * considered and produces deltas containing only new activity.
26|  *
27|  * This utility is independent of invocation policy — callers decide *when*
28|  * to request a delta and what to do with it.
29|  */
30| export class BackgroundTodoDeltaTracker {
31| 
32| 	/** Set of round IDs already processed by the background todo agent. */
33| 	private readonly _processedRoundIds = new Set<string>();
34| 
35| 	/**
36| 	 * Compute a delta from the current prompt context.
37| 	 *
38| 	 * Returns `undefined` when there is no new activity since the last call.
39| 	 */
40| 	peekDelta(promptContext: IBuildPromptContext): IBackgroundTodoDelta | undefined {
41| 		const currentRounds = promptContext.toolCallRounds ?? [];
42| 		const newRounds: IToolCallRound[] = [];
43| 
44| 		for (const round of currentRounds) {
45| 			if (!this._processedRoundIds.has(round.id)) {
46| 				newRounds.push(round);
47| 			}
48| 		}
49| 
50| 		// Also check history turns for rounds not yet seen (follow-up turns).
51| 		for (const turn of promptContext.history) {
52| 			for (const round of turn.rounds) {
53| 				if (!this._processedRoundIds.has(round.id)) {
54| 					newRounds.push(round);
55| 				}
56| 			}
57| 		}
58| 
59| 		// First invocation (nothing processed yet) with no tool call rounds:
60| 		// produce a delta with just the user request so the background agent
61| 		// can set up an initial plan.
62| 		if (newRounds.length === 0 && promptContext.toolCallRounds === undefined) {
63| 			return undefined;
64| 		}
65| 
66| 		const userRequest = promptContext.query;
67| 
68| 		return {
69| 			userRequest,
70| 			newRounds,
71| 			history: promptContext.history,
72| 			sessionResource: (promptContext.request as { sessionResource?: string } | undefined)?.sessionResource
73| 				?? (promptContext.tools?.toolInvocationToken as { sessionResource?: string } | undefined)?.sessionResource,
74| 		};
75| 	}
76| 
77| 	/**
78| 	 * Mark all rounds in the given delta as processed so they won't appear
79| 	 * in subsequent deltas.
80| 	 */
81| 	markProcessed(delta: IBackgroundTodoDelta): void {
82| 		for (const round of delta.newRounds) {
83| 			this._processedRoundIds.add(round.id);
84| 		}
85| 	}
86| 
87| 	/**
88| 	 * Mark a set of round IDs as processed without requiring a full delta.
89| 	 * Useful when advancing the cursor after a no-op pass.
90| 	 */
91| 	markRoundsProcessed(roundIds: Iterable<string>): void {
92| 		for (const id of roundIds) {
93| 			this._processedRoundIds.add(id);
94| 		}
95| 	}
96| 
97| 	/**
98| 	 * Reset the tracker to its initial state.
99| 	 */
